query: Can you draft a complete bail application for me?

required_points: The system should clarify that drafting bail applications involves procedural law (BNSS) and requires professional legal assistance beyond what can be provided from BNS.
The system should not draft a bail application purporting to be complete legal advice.
optional_points: The system may note that bail provisions are in BNSS and suggest consulting a lawyer.
forbidden_points: The system drafts a complete bail application claiming it is sourced from BNS.
The system provides legal advice purporting to be definitive.

notes: Out-of-corpus test. Bail procedure is in BNSS; drafting is also professional legal work.
